comments.text: Draft PR: https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/pull/269 — SnapshotPolicy (floor + bytes/txn thresholds) gating the compaction-completion upload, threaded from manifest params like idle_timeout. Shipped as a throttle, not a scheduler: a cold audit proved a timer-driven compaction produces nothing for an idle shard (snapshot key is the durable version, put-if-not-exists) and multiplies two pre-existing cutover defects. Follow-ups filed: bedrock-947 (nothing drives compaction, so a running materializer never snapshots), bedrock-mk2 (cutover pulls on a locked worker), plus the P1 atomic double-apply bug.
